description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the Device Registry component's Device Registration AMQP endpoint. It contains setup and cleanup methods for integration testing, using Vertx and JUnit 5 extensions, focusing on testing device registration functionalities via AMQP.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationAmqpIT
classes.description: A JUnit 5 based integration test class for testing device registration over AMQP in the Device Registry component.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by setting up the registry client and connecting the registration client.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Performs cleanup after each test by deleting registry objects.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the test environment by disconnecting the registration client and releasing resources.

methods.name: getHelper
methods.description: Returns the helper object for interacting with the test environment.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a Future of RegistrationClient for a specific tenant.
